meta.title: Login succeeds but user is immediately redirected back to /login — TransformInterceptor envelope not unwrapped on frontend

content.tldr: Admin could authenticate successfully (POST /auth/login returned 200) but was sent back to /login immediately. The accessToken was never stored in Zustand because the frontend read data.accessToken from the raw axios response, while the backend TransformInterceptor wraps every response as { data: <payload>, meta: { timestamp } }.
content.environment: frontend (React + Zustand) — all auth + product API calls. Reproducible with any role including admin.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe: the page navigates to /products then immediately bounces back to /login.
Open DevTools → Application → Local Storage → 'eam-auth': confirm accessToken is null.
content.expected_behavior: After successful login, accessToken and refreshToken are stored in Zustand (persisted to localStorage), and the user stays on /products.
content.actual_behavior: POST /auth/login returns HTTP 200 with body { data: { accessToken, refreshToken, user }, meta: { timestamp } }. The frontend did apiClient.post<LoginResponse>('/auth/login'), then read data.accessToken — but axios data here is the full envelope { data: {...}, meta: {...} }, so data.accessToken is undefined. setTokens(undefined, undefined) is called; RequireAuth sees null accessToken and redirects to /login.
content.root_cause: The global NestJS TransformInterceptor (backend/src/common/interceptors/transform.interceptor.ts) wraps every response payload. The frontend api-client.ts had NO envelope-unwrapping logic, so every apiClient call received the envelope as the payload. This silently broke login (and would have broken all product API calls too once auth was working).
content.regression_risk: Low. The unwrap guard uses hasOwnProperty('data') — only envelopes match. Any non-envelope response (e.g. 204 No Content) passes through unchanged.

audit.author: vibe-qa-general
audit.note: Bug reported by user: logged in as admin, cannot access /products. Root cause identified: TransformInterceptor envelope not unwrapped.

audit.author: vibe-frontend-general
audit.note: Added response interceptor to api-client.ts to unwrap { data, meta } envelope. Fixed refresh-token raw axios path separately. Branch: fix/BUG-0003-api-envelope-unwrap.
